description: This file is a header file for the vendor module manager in a C/C++ project. It declares functions for loading, initializing, deinitializing, unloading, and configuring vendor modules, along with necessary includes and license information.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_loadInternal
methods.description: Loads vendor modules registered in the local namespace.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_loadExternal
methods.description: Loads vendor modules from a specified shared object file.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_loadExternalDir
methods.description: Finds and loads vendor modules from all shared object files in a directory.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_initAll
methods.description: Initializes all loaded vendor modules with provided info.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_unloadAll
methods.description: Unloads all vendor modules and closes external shared objects if applicable.

methods.name: wld_vendorModuleMgr_loadDefaultsAll
methods.description: Loads default data model configurations for all vendor modules.
